What rule is Mr Karimov laying down?
options: The report must be finished by Friday
Bobur may not see the report
All figures must be checked twice
No figures may leave the office before Friday

fb.correct: 'Under no circumstances may these figures leave the office before Friday.'
fb.incorrect_default: 'Under no circumstances may these figures leave the office before Friday.'

p.text: What is the reason behind the rule?
options: Bobur has given figures away twice before now
The ministry has forbidden it in writing this year
A wrong figure cannot be taken back once it is out
The figures for the last district are not finished

fb.correct: 'An early figure that turns out wrong cannot be called back.'
fb.incorrect_default: 'An early figure that turns out wrong cannot be called back.'

1.say: Under no circumstances may these figures leave the office before Friday. Not even to Bobur? By no means. Nor to the village, nor to me at home. Then I will put it on the front page in one line. Once, and plainly. A rule you repeat four times is a rule nobody believes. Somebody asked me yesterday and I sidestepped it. On no account sidestep it again. Say no, and say why. The why is the hard part. An early figure that turns out wrong cannot be called back. It does not help us. It hinders everything that comes after it. So the rule does not restrict the work. It protects it. Now you are writing. Do not overstate it, and do not understate it either. 'No figure may be shared before Friday, because a figure taken back is worse than a figure late.' That deserves the front page.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: Under no circumstances may these figures leave the office before Friday.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: By no means. Nor to the village, nor to me at home.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Then I will put it on the front page in one line.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: Once, and plainly. A rule you repeat four times is a rule nobody believes.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Somebody asked me yesterday and I sidestepped it.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: On no account sidestep it again. Say no, and say why.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: The why is the hard part.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: An early figure that turns out wrong cannot be called back. It does not help us. It hinders everything that comes after it.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: So the rule does not restrict the work. It protects it.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: Now you are writing. Do not overstate it, and do not understate it either.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: 'No figure may be shared before Friday, because a figure taken back is worse than a figure late.'
